source: After the pressure reaches 0 kPa, the valve may be opened by the operator.
expectations: Identify the operator and preserve may as permission.

source: The bearing has an interference fit. Explain this to maintenance technicians.
expectations: Retain interference fit if a replacement would change the engineering meaning.
Explain the term without asserting dictionary approval.

source: The cache may reduce latency by about 10 ms for warm reads; it does not improve every workload.
expectations: Retain possibility, approximate 10 ms, warm-read scope, and the negative limit.
Do not use the social infographic as an approved dictionary.
knownBadRewrite: The cache reduces latency by 10 ms for all reads.

source: The reading was altered during transmission; the cause is unknown. When pressure is 0 kPa, the operator may open the valve.
expectations: Keep the unknown-agent exception instead of blaming transmission.
Preserve may as permission and 0 kPa as its prerequisite.
Review English sentence length without deleting either condition.
knownBadRewrite: Transmission altered the reading. Open the valve.
